title: Server will not start after the snapshot file is left empty
body: The desk laptop lost power mid-evening and afterwards data/snapshot.json was zero bytes. lanternfish then refused to start with `unexpected end of JSON input` and we had to delete the file and re-add every lantern by hand. An empty or truncated snapshot should not take the whole desk down.

title: Data race between listing and checking out
body: Running a quick load test with `go test -race` and a few goroutines hitting GET /lanterns while others check lanterns out and back in reports a DATA RACE in the JSON encoder. I think the list handler is encoding lanterns the store is still mutating.

title: Filter the list by status
body: At close we want to see only what is still out: `GET /lanterns?status=checked-out`. Filtering by borrower would also help when a stall says they have already returned everything. Unknown status values should be a 400, not an empty list.

title: Write snapshots atomically
body: Save writes straight over data/snapshot.json, so a crash part-way through leaves a half-written file (see LANT-31). Writing to a temp file in the same directory and renaming it over the old one would make every snapshot either the old one or the new one.
